intro.name: Ken Ashe
headline: Making sense of AI.
Making things with it.
intro.text: I explain AI in plain English and put it to work on real projects, from apps and videos to new business ideas. Follow along to learn something useful and see what I try next.
intro.positioning: A creator who makes AI understandable and explores what people can do with it through clear explanations, real projects, and stories from his own work.

homeAbout: I spent about twenty years in finance and in project and product roles, and I’m a CPA and a PMP. Then I left corporate work to make things with AI and explain what I learn along the way.
This site is where the videos, projects and writing live. I also run Lucky Domains, a digital presence studio for the AI era.
draft.aboutLead: I’m an AI creator and builder based in New Jersey. I make AI understandable and explore what people can do with it, through clear explanations, real projects and stories from my own work.
aboutBackground: I started my career in accounting and finance, earning my CPA and working in financial reporting before moving into project, product and program leadership. Over roughly two decades I worked at S&P Global, EY, Noom and Prudential Financial, where I finished as Director of Project and Product Management.
Alongside that work I built digital businesses. I later left corporate work to focus on entrepreneurship and on making, and explaining, practical things with AI.
